description: This file defines a mock class MediaKeysClientMock for unit testing, which implements the IMediaKeysClient interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to media key handling such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes.

classes.name: MediaKeysClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysClient interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Mock method to handle license request events, taking session ID, license request message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Mock method to handle license renewal events, taking session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Mock method to handle key status change events, taking session ID and key statuses.
